Z=(Q(0),Q(0));O=(Q(1),Q(0));S=(Q(0),Q(1))

def m(x,y):return(x[0]*y[0]+3*x[1]*y[1],x[0]*y[1]+x[1]*y[0])
def sm(xs):
 z=Z
 for x in xs:z=a(z,x)
 return z
